purpose: Freeze the observed two-bundle EarthExplorer transport shape and exact post-transfer identity checks before any owner acquisition decision. The earlier host-neutral MTL.json and eighteen-separate-asset transport assumptions do not apply to this route.
selected_option: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Product Bundle; one full bundle per exact scene, not either separate Download All Files Now band-group control
pre_request_checks_if_later_approved: Confirm the signed-in browser still shows the exact product ID and the full Level-2 Product Bundle for each date; do not use M2M, another host, or a substitute scene.

Freeze a unique non-Git staging and final path under the established external project data root, verify free space and collision absence, and reserve append-only attempt and terminal receipt identities before each request.

Freeze an explicit browser-download handoff that waits for a completed download event, obtains its local path, and moves or copies the exact completed file into unique non-Git staging without recording cookies, signed URLs, tokens, or account identifiers. If the browser cannot expose a completed local file safely, stop and revise the transport method.

proposed_transfer_controls_if_later_appr.fixed_order: before, then early_after; a shared account, source-identity, security, or storage failure stops both
proposed_transfer_controls_if_later_appr.attempts: Append-only identities for each owner-initiated download and any safe recovery; no silent retry or attempt-path reuse. The future owner decision must state any exact request or recovery limit.
proposed_transfer_controls_if_later_appr.resume: Do not resume a partial browser transfer unless the provider and browser expose unchanged strong object identity and verified range semantics; otherwise preserve available failure evidence and start a distinct byte-zero attempt only within the approved envelope.
proposed_transfer_controls_if_later_appr.browser_transport_limitation: A browser may issue internal range requests or retries without exposing them. Count and audit owner-initiated Download Product actions, and make no stronger HTTP-attempt claim than observable evidence supports.
proposed_transfer_controls_if_later_appr.promotion: Atomic no-replace only after verification; preserve failed and partial attempts outside Git when available

post_transfer_container_checks: Record actual bundle filename, byte length, and SHA-256. The rounded 1.05 GiB display is only a capacity estimate; no upstream cryptographic digest or exact expected byte length was observed.

Determine actual archive format from the delivered file and open it without extracting or following links; reject traversal, unsafe member types, duplicates, missing required members, truncation, and unexpected product-prefixed identity.
Read both MTL.txt and MTL.xml as metadata only and require LANDSAT_PRODUCT_ID and LANDSAT_SCENE_ID to match the exact frozen pair and member prefixes. Do not expect MTL.json from EarthExplorer.

Stream every archive member to completion for structural integrity and local member hashes before any no-replace promotion; record that local hashes do not prove equality to an unpublished upstream checksum.

synthetic_only_verifier_candidate.scope: TAR structure, safe paths/types, complete member reads, required roles, exact MTL.txt/XML identifiers, and local hashes only; no real archive has been inspected and no pixel may be read under this plan

separate_later_gates: Archive verification does not establish TIFF header or pixel fitness. A distinct approved read must verify required TIFF structure, EPSG:32645, 30 m grid, data types, scale, nodata, scene-pair lattice, and AOI masks.
A 30 m Landsat visual panel or observed-change route needs its own frozen method and review; the existing Sentinel-2 20 m thresholds and mask implementation cannot be silently reused.
No verified transfer alone establishes usable pixels, a map, observable change, event causation, or publication readiness.
